items.title: New Academic Year Opens
items.body: Over 800 students returned for the 2025–2026 academic year. New teachers welcomed, timetables distributed, and the year began with renewed energy across all forms.

items.title: Cultural Day 2025
items.body: Students and staff delivered a spectacular display of Caribbean and global culture. The performance hall transformed into a stage of colour, music and dance.

items.title: CSEC Awards Ceremony
items.body: Recognition of McGrath's Class of 2025 — one of the strongest CSEC performances in the school's history. Multiple students achieved perfect scores across several subjects.

items.title: Boys' Day Celebration
items.body: McGrath's annual celebration of its male students — a day of recognition, motivation and pride honouring achievement in academics, sports, arts and character.

items.title: Girls' Day Celebration
items.body: A powerful day honouring the young women of McGrath. Awards, performances and addresses celebrating the strength, intelligence and excellence of our female students.

items.title: ISSA Manning Cup
items.body: McGrath's boys football team represented the school with pride in the ISSA/Digicel Manning Cup regional competition — demonstrating teamwork, skill and the McGrath fighting spirit.

items.title: Inter-House Sports Day
items.body: The stadium came alive as students competed across track and field for house glory. Personal bests broken, school records challenged, team spirit at its absolute peak.

items.title: Graduation Day 2026
items.body: The Class of 2026 crossed the stage to receive their certificates. A milestone moment for students, parents and teachers — five years of dedication celebrated.
